meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

copy.tagline: 处理分子生物学序列和自动分析生物信息数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理生物信息学数据，需要自动化分析流程。
copy.tagline_en: Manipulate molecular sequences and automate bioinformatics analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly work with bioinformatics data and need automated analysis pipelines.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能利用Biopython处理生物学序列、读写FASTA/GenBank等文件、访问NCBI数据库、运行BLAST搜索、构建系统发育树等。
howto.when: 当你需要处理DNA/RNA/蛋白质序列、读写FASTA/GenBank/PDB文件、访问NCBI数据库、运行BLAST或构建系统发育树时触发。

say.text: 帮我用Biopython读取这个FASTA文件并计算GC含量。
say.note: Claude会解析文件并输出序列的GC百分比。

say.text: 用Biopython对这段序列进行BLAST搜索。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to use Biopython for biological sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA, GenBank, PDB), NCBI database access, BLAST searches, phylogenetics, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to process DNA/RNA/protein sequences, read/write bio file formats, access NCBI databases, run BLAST, or construct phylogenetic trees.

say_en.text: Use Biopython to read this FASTA file and calculate GC content.
say_en.note: Claude will parse the file and output GC percentage.

say_en.text: Use Biopython to download GenBank sequence EU490707.
say_en.note: Claude will call Entrez to fetch the record.

say_en.text: Use Biopython to BLAST this sequence.
say_en.note: Claude will run NCBI web BLAST and return top hits.
